SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS num_patients
FROM admissiondiagnoses
JOIN hospitaladmissions ON admissiondiagnoses.admissionid = hospitaladmissions.admissionid
WHERE STRFTIME('%d', STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', admissiondiagnoses.recordeddatetime)) >= STRFTIME('%d', STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', CURRENT_DATE)) - 90
AND admissiondiagnoses.icdcode IN (
    SELECT icdcode
    FROM diagnosiscodes
    WHERE icdcode LIKE 'C00%' -- Breast cancer ICD-10 codes
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS num_patients
FROM hospitaladmissions
JOIN admissiondiagnoses ON hospitaladmissions.recordid = admissiondiagnoses.recordid
JOIN diagnosiscodes ON admissiondiagnoses.icdcode = diagnosiscodes.icdcode
WHERE admissiondiagnoses.recordid IN (
    SELECT recordid
    FROM admissiondiagnoses
    WHERE recordeddatetime >= DATE('now', '-90 days')
) AND diagnosiscodes.icdcode = 'C50'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.row_id) AS num_patients_with_breast_cancer
FROM admissions a
JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
JOIN d_icd_diagnoses i ON d.icd_code = i.icd_code
WHERE i.long_title LIKE '%breast cancer%' AND a.admittime >= DATE('now', '-90 days');

SELECT DISTINCT d.recordid, d.admissionid, d.recordeddatetime
FROM diagnosiscodes d
JOIN admissiondiagnoses ad ON d.recordid = ad.recordid
WHERE d.icdcode = 'ICD9-CM:469.1' AND ad.patientid = 10020786
ORDER BY d.recordeddatetime ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(charttime) AS first_diagnosis_date
FROM diagnoses_icd
JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id
JOIN d_icd_diagnoses ON diagnoses_icd.icd_code = d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code
WHERE subject_id = 10020786 AND long_title = 'COPD';

SELECT MIN(charttime) AS first_diagnosis_date
FROM diagnoses_icd
JOIN d_icd_diagnoses ON diagnoses_icd.icd_code = d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code
WHERE subject_id = 10020786 AND icd_code = 'COPD'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.recordid, T1.recordeddatetime
FROM admissionprocedures AS T1
JOIN hospitaladmissions AS T2 ON T1.patientid = T2.patientid
JOIN procedurecodes AS T3 ON T1.icdcode = T3.icdcode
WHERE T1.patientid = 10014729 AND T3.description LIKE '%resection%'

SELECT DISTINCT d_icd_procedures.icd_code, d_icd_procedures.long_title
FROM procedures_icd
JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id
JOIN d_icd_procedures ON procedures_icd.icd_code = d_icd_procedures.icd_code
WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10014729 AND d_icd_procedures.long_title LIKE '%resection%'

SELECT DISTINCT d_icd_procedures.icd_code, d_icd_procedures.charttime
FROM admissions
JOIN d_icd_procedures ON admissions.hadm_id = d_icd_procedures.hadm_id
WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10014729 AND d_icd_procedures.icd_code LIKE '%resection%'

SELECT lr.resultvalue
FROM labresults lr
JOIN hospitaladmissions ha ON lr.admissionid = ha.admissionid
WHERE ha.patientid = 10008287 AND ha.admissionid = (SELECT MAX(admissionid) FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10008287)

SELECT lr.resultvalue
FROM labresults lr
JOIN labtesttypes lt ON lr.itemcode = lt.itemcode
JOIN hospitaladmissions ha ON lr.patientid = ha.patientid
WHERE ha.patientid = 10008287 AND ha.admissionid = (SELECT MAX(admissionid) FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10008287)

SELECT DISTINCT l.valuenum
FROM labevents l
JOIN admissions a ON l.hadm_id = a.hadm_id
WHERE a.subject_id = 10008287
ORDER BY l.charttime DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT l.*
FROM labevents l
JOIN admissions a ON l.subject_id = a.subject_id
WHERE a.subject_id = 10008287
ORDER BY l.charttime DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.lab_result_time
FROM icupatient AS T1
JOIN lab AS T2 ON T1.unit_id = T2.unit_id
WHERE T1.patient_id = '027-100559' AND T2.lab_name = 'Lipase' AND T2.lab_result >= 180
ORDER BY T1.hospital_discharge_time DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.lab_result_time
FROM icupatient AS T1
JOIN lab AS T2 ON T1.unit_id = T2.unit_id
WHERE T1.patient_id = '027-100559' AND T2.lab_name = 'Lipase' AND T2.lab_result >= 180
ORDER BY T1.hospital_discharge_time DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.labresulttime
FROM lab AS T1
JOIN patient AS T2 ON T1.patientunitstayid = T2.patientunitstayid
WHERE T2.uniquepid = '027-100559'
  AND T1.labname = 'Lipase'
  AND T1.labresult > 180
ORDER BY T1.labresulttime DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.labresulttime
FROM lab AS T1
JOIN patient AS T2 ON T1.patientunitstayid = T2.patientunitstayid
WHERE T2.uniquepid = '027-100559'
  AND T1.labname = 'Lipase'
  AND T1.labresult > 180
ORDER BY T1.labresulttime DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.condition_name, c.condition_time
FROM condition c
JOIN icupatient i ON c.unit_id = i.unit_id
WHERE i.patient_id = '017-100143' AND c.condition_name LIKE '%acute pulmonary edema%';

SELECT c.condition_name, c.condition_time
FROM condition c
JOIN icupatient i ON c.unit_id = i.unit_id
WHERE i.patient_id = '017-100143' AND c.condition_name LIKE '%acute pulmonary edema%';

SELECT 
    d.diagnosisname AS diagnosis_name,
    d.diagnosistime AS diagnosis_time
FROM 
    diagnosis d
JOIN 
    patient p ON d.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid
WHERE 
    p.uniquepid = '017-100143' AND 
    d.diagnosisname LIKE '%acute pulmonary edema%';

SELECT 
    d.diagnosisname AS diagnosis,
    d.diagnosistime AS diagnosis_time
FROM 
    diagnosis d
JOIN 
    patient p ON d.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid
WHERE 
    p.uniquepid = '017-100143' AND 
    d.diagnosisname LIKE '%acute pulmonary edema%';

SELECT 
    t.treatment_name,
    MAX(ih.hospital_discharge_time) AS latest_discharge_time
FROM 
    icupatient ih
JOIN 
    treatment t ON ih.unit_id = t.unit_id
WHERE 
    ih.patient_id = '007-10050'
GROUP BY 
    t.treatment_name;

SELECT 
    t.treatment_name,
    MAX(ih.hospital_discharge_time) AS latest_time
FROM 
    icupatient ih
JOIN 
    treatment t ON ih.unit_id = t.unit_id
WHERE 
    ih.patient_id = '007-10050'
GROUP BY 
    t.treatment_name;

SELECT 
    t.treatmentname AS treatment_name,
    MAX(t.treatmenttime) AS latest_time
FROM 
    patient p
JOIN 
    treatment t ON p.patientunitstayid = t.patientunitstayid
WHERE 
    p.uniquepid = '007-10050' AND 
    t.treatmentname = 'chest x-ray'
GROUP BY 
    t.treatmentname;

SELECT 
    t.treatmentname AS treatment_name,
    MAX(t.treatmenttime) AS latest_time
FROM 
    patient p
JOIN 
    treatment t ON p.patientunitstayid = t.patientunitstayid
WHERE 
    p.uniquepid = '007-10050' AND 
    t.treatmentname = 'chest x-ray'
GROUP BY 
    t.treatmentname;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.lab_name, T2.lab_result
FROM icupatient AS T1
JOIN lab AS T2 ON T1.unit_id = T2.unit_id
WHERE T1.patient_id = '027-101455' AND T1.hospital_admission_source = 'First Admission'
ORDER BY T1.hospital_admission_source, T1.hospital_admit_time
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.lab_name, T2.lab_result
FROM icupatient AS T1
JOIN lab AS T2 ON T1.unit_id = T2.unit_id
WHERE T1.patient_id = '027-101455' AND T1.hospital_admission_source = 'First Admission'
ORDER BY T1.hospital_admission_source, T1.hospital_admit_time
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    labresult
FROM 
    lab
WHERE 
    patientunitstayid = (
        SELECT 
            patientunitstayid
        FROM 
            patient
        WHERE 
            uniquepid = '027-101455'
    )
    AND labname = 'wbc x 1000'

SELECT 
    "labresult" AS wbc_x_1000
FROM 
    lab
WHERE 
    "patientunitstayid" = (
        SELECT 
            "patientunitstayid"
        FROM 
            patient
        WHERE 
            "uniquepid" = '027-101455'
    )
    AND "labname" = 'WBC'
    AND "labresulttime" = (
        SELECT 
            MIN("labresulttime")
        FROM 
            lab
        WHERE 
            "patientunitstayid" = (
                SELECT 
                    "patientunitstayid"
                FROM 
                    patient
                WHERE 
                    "uniquepid" = '027-101455'
            )
    );
